answer: A newcomer receives a 24-epoch credit ceiling that grows only after unrelated buyers settle verified jobs. The kth account in one funding reef must serve k distinct buyers before its ceiling rises, so 100 aliases require 5,050 external settlements. A public lantern draw audits 10% of receipts against task hashes and payments. A hollow buyer, reused invoice, or failed result resets every linked ceiling and burns a 30-POA bond per account.
